source.source: Self-authored editable Unity hare and tortoise meshes in MotionAnimalSubjects.cs. No matching rabbit or tortoise asset in the imported library.
source.positionSource: Each figure follows the same MotionMathModel.Sample as its plotted point. Comparison bodies are vertically separated for clarity only.

changes.011: A stopping and reversing hare and a steady tortoise move on separate tracks with a common x-axis.
changes.013: x(t)=2+4t−½t² has x(0)=2, x(2)=8; the 0–2 s secant remains fixed as the hare slows down. Average speed on this monotone interval is 3 m/s.
changes.016: The moving point reaches t=2.5 min; the secant explicitly joins the second point at 3.0 min and the two endpoint labels align with the curve.
